execution_frontier.summary: DWC exact-ID acoustic adaptation is verified through Stage C. Stage A completed 100 batches/200 optimizer steps; Stage B completed 200 batches/400 optimizer steps on all 799 synthetic rows and reached 123/125 machine waveform acceptance; Stage C completed 100 targeted batches/200 optimizer steps and reached 125/125 machine waveform acceptance. The exact Stage-C weights were reassembled in the current conversation and matched their recorded SHA-256. Human CNS auditory scoring is also a required perceptual gate and cannot be substituted by waveform sanity checks.
